svg.title: Nyx Kit proposal 3: Separated letters
svg.desc: Aligned N with distinct parallel X and Y rising strokes. Each upper arm aligns with its corresponding lower continuation. Parallel strokes, crossing breaks and lower-left terminal clearance use a consistent 16-unit visible gap. All additional X and Y strokes remain detached from the N, including the upper-right terminal. Rounded terminals and joins soften the finished mark.
